evidence.title: Cap: Screen Recording, Sharing, and Video Collaboration
Cap — Free Screen Recorder & Open Source Loom Alternative

name: Cap
summary: Open-source screen recorder and Loom alternative for Mac, Windows and Linux with instant share links.
description: An open-source screen recorder and async video platform for Mac, Windows and Linux. Instant Mode uploads while recording so the share link is ready at stop; Studio Mode records locally in 4K with an editor for backgrounds, automatic zoom, captions and cursor effects; Screenshot Mode beautifies stills. Caps get comments, transcripts, chapters and analytics, with cloud, Google Drive or S3 storage, Loom import, and a CLI plus MCP server for AI agents.
contains: open source: most of the repo AGPLv3, some crates MIT
three modes: Instant, Studio and Screenshot
desktop apps for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux
cloud, Google Drive or S3-compatible storage
comments, transcripts, chapters and analytics on Cap pages
Loom import; REST API, CLI and MCP server for agents
commercial desktop license $29/year; Cap Pro $12 per user per month
